question_en: list the most famous movies and TV series shot in Vancouver
question_fr: Liste les films et séries télévisées les plus célèbres tournés à Vancouver
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o (gpt-6-sol since 2026-10-01) through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT U.ID_CONTENT, U.CONTENT_TYPE FROM ((SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE AS ID_CONTENT, 'movie' AS CONTENT_TYPE, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.POPULARITY AS SORT_KEY FROM T_WC_T2S_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION ON T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_LOCATION_ANCESTOR ON T_WC_T2S_LOCATION_ANCESTOR.ID_LOCATION = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION JOIN T_WC_T2S_LOCATION ON T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION = T_WC_T2S_LOCATION_ANCESTOR.ID_ANCESTOR WHERE T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.ID_WIKIDATA = 'Q24639' AND T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.DELETED = 0 AND T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.LOCATION_ROLE = 'filming' ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.POPULARITY DESC LIMIT 5) UNION ALL (SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_SERIE.ID_SERIE AS ID_CONTENT, 'serie' AS CONTENT_TYPE, T_WC_T2S_SERIE.POPULARITY AS SORT_KEY FROM T_WC_T2S_SERIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_SERIE_LOCATION ON T_WC_T2S_SERIE_LOCATION.ID_SERIE = T_WC_T2S_SERIE.ID_SERIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_LOCATION_ANCESTOR ON T_WC_T2S_LOCATION_ANCESTOR.ID_LOCATION = T_WC_T2S_SERIE_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION JOIN T_WC_T2S_LOCATION ON T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION = T_WC_T2S_LOCATION_ANCESTOR.ID_ANCESTOR WHERE T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.ID_WIKIDATA = 'Q24639' AND T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.DELETED = 0 AND T_WC_T2S_SERIE_LOCATION.LOCATION_ROLE = 'filming' ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_SERIE.POPULARITY DESC LIMIT 5)) AS U ORDER BY U.SORT_KEY DESC LIMIT 10
